## Scope and Security

- The change is read-only guidance and administrator navigation for existing workflows.
- No database, API, storage, external service, infrastructure, package, or authorization model change was introduced.
- The sidebar condition does not replace server-side middleware enforcement.
- No credentials, private keys, tokens, or participant data were added.
- The four GIFs are public static presentation assets containing only light-theme seeded local portal screens and visible pointers; no credentials or personal member records are included.
